input: Find a local figure drawing class to attend monthly

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing the user's city or neighborhood is essential to finding classes that are actually local and reachable.
Figure drawing classes vary widely — drop-in open studio sessions, structured courses with instruction, workshops, or life drawing events. The type changes where to look and what to sign up for.
The user's skill level (beginner vs. experienced) determines which classes are appropriate and what kind of instruction or environment they need.
Budget affects whether to target free community sessions, low-cost art center classes, or private studio workshops, which are often significantly more expensive.
Preferred day or time of week determines which specific sessions are viable, since most classes run on fixed schedules.
Some people want a social, drop-in atmosphere; others want structured feedback from an instructor. This shapes which venue type to prioritize.
Knowing what the user wants to get out of attending — skill improvement, creative habit, social connection — defines what a good outcome looks like and helps filter options.
